scope: Independent CPU2 two-tetrahedron implementation checks; no cohort or observation access; no pinned-source edits

initial_test_failure_preserved.cause: Force-resultant float64 sum differed by 5.551115123125783e-17 N, beyond initial overly literal 5e-17 N assertion
initial_test_failure_preserved.resolution: Test allowance uses documented 64*eps*magnitude float64 summation bound; no load/model/solver changes in response

mechanics.elasticity: Compressible objective log-J Neo-Hookean with compatible nodal F; original energy reused read-only
mechanics.interactions: S2 normalized material-frame vertex-lumped Gaussian quadrature, world-frame finite PSD K/D; H2 normalized known world loads
mechanics.integration: Implicit Euler stationary incremental potential with exact optional node-axis elimination and prescribed target backward-chord velocities
mechanics.solver: Dense original-objective Newton Hessian if SPD, otherwise declared SPD rest dynamic metric descent; positive-J Armijo search and decreasing residual near roundoff; no objective/stiffness/J/covariance repair
mechanics.failure: Explicit StepFailure with residual history and unmodified input state at line-search/iteration failure; threshold and regularization=0 reported
mechanics.work_identity: Delta(T+Uelastic+Usupport) = Wexternal+Wtarget+Wreaction - h*dissipation - kinetic_backward_Euler_term - spring_backward_Euler_term - signed_elastic_Bregman + free_residual_work
mechanics.mass: Only lumped tetrahedral solid masses enter inertia; material Gaussians carry the same material mass, never added mass

meaningful_checks: Finite 1.9-radian rigid rest rotation has zero energy/force; passive rotation/translation of reference, patch shapes, K/D and controls yields rotated trajectory
Autograd energy gradient independently matches analytic first-Piola stress assembly and directional finite differences; spring gradient matches force
Rest Hessian agrees with independent small-strain assembly and tiny-force step agrees with linear implicit Euler
Known Gaussian controls change response; H2 resultants plus gravity match physical total force within explicit floating-point bound
Passive fixture trajectory dissipates energy; moving exact pin and compliant targets satisfy reaction/actuator work identity
Positive-J inversion rejection, explicit iteration-cap failure and input-state preservation
Affine material Gaussian F/covariance transport and density-volume mass conservation
Same continuous force law, full trajectories at 60/120/240 Hz show refinement contraction
Inactive load slots reject even 1e-30 N commanded force instead of silently dropping a known action

limitations: Signed nonlinear elastic Bregman term is not guaranteed nonnegative
No contact or exact rigid handles
Gaussian covariance is shape extent, not uncertainty
Tiny fixed discretization only; no continuum or large-load convergence qualification
No contact integrated; separate world-plane primitive is not called
No exact finite rigid handles or current prediction/inference model replacement
Nonlinear elastic Bregman is signed, so no global nonconvex energy monotonicity assertion
Gaussians describe material/interaction shape, not calibrated uncertainty
No current cohort or reserved responses read; no GPU calls
